paired_placement_status.status: Unchanged source-bound study: top-edge right-angle KVM and matched repack, not yet routed or admitted. The mechanical preview is not a new reviewed PCB.
paired_placement_status.constraints: Preserve fixed mating registration, 22 mm nominal gap, reservoir vent allocations, pinouts and current margins. No left-edge Hub KVM exit.

implemented: Generic bounded read-only raised-SMT bridge probe; model-authored poses, no placement search or native board save.
Actual pad/track copper edges, saved filled zones, drill envelopes, component reservations, external outline, component keepouts and source netclass/base clearances.
Current requirement rederived from the unchanged source current authority, including its conductor margin; catalog rating does not grant thermal or joint qualification.
Input/family/output-alias protection, including bound policy JSON and future saved-family namespace.
Explicit provisional two-land native KiCad footprint; no fictitious PCB copper across the real off-board metal span.
Visual inspection preserves saved copper holes and actual drills rather than painting across them.

12V.direct_trial: Rejected: two upper-land VBUS copper conflicts and lower SMT land over an input through-hole. Span crosses different-net J3.23.
12V.offset_trial: No land copper/drill conflicts, but four nearby input holes leave approximately 0.3 mm nominal body-to-hole clearance against the retained 0.5 mm mechanical allocation. Neither foot is connected to the existing force path.

3V3.status: Rejected on catalog rating; no reduced current requirement or parallel-sharing assumption.

MJP.material: Copper for MJP-1.0 specifically; not the shorter phosphor-bronze family members.

actual_ATX_J3.drawing_identity: SD-5569-002 rev M4, page 2 part table includes 39-29-1247; manufacturer-authored mirrored copy inspected when official local download timed out.
actual_ATX_J3.conclusion: The bar's 1.8 mm nominal lift does not guarantee clearance over the input pin. Range excludes solder, board thickness and assembly tolerances; shorter actual pins may fit. No trimming process has been approved or qualified.

narrow_flat_bar_followup.candidate_family: Rhythm/Kyoshin 1.5 mm square tinned-copper SMD bars; SD02112-2K 20 mm, SD02113-2K heading states 30 mm.
narrow_flat_bar_followup.source_discrepancy: Current SD02113 page heading says 30 mm, but its detail row says 10 mm; obtain the dimensioned drawing before footprint/adoption. Old kyoshin-k PDF links now return 404.
narrow_flat_bar_followup.advantage_to_test: Narrow reinforcement of existing 6.535523 mm force corridors without the raised-bridge pin crossing; potential freed corridor is not a measured package-size reduction.
narrow_flat_bar_followup.limitations: Flat bars cannot be treated as route-under bridges. Land pattern, solder, thermal/current qualification, source graph and assembled cost remain open. No part is ordered or added to the production BOM.

native_connectivity_experiment.conclusion: KiCad does not credit a real off-board bridge automatically. Separate nets can show zero opens without proving assembly conduction. A real two-terminal schematic component and explicit assembly conductor/current model are mandatory; never add fake PCB copper or a net-tie shortcut.

next_required: Continue the source-bound matched placement repack and reconstruct changed real routes before any promotion; no automatic propagation from preview to review.
Check the narrow flat-bar drawing, price and assembly capability against a measured complete-package saving before selecting the BOM.
Implement actual off-board conductor/current and thermal receiving before removing native high-current copper.
